events.title: Playtest #2 Is Live: Return to the Mud
events.summary: Drag your friends into the arena, betray them, and take the crown. 🛠️ WHAT’S NEW IN PLAYTEST #2? New Game ModesSoccer & Survival: Kick balls or avoid dying. Standard royal pastimes.Race & Hold the Trophy: Run fast. Hoard shiny objects.Last Pig Standing: Deathmatch has been restructured. Points are now awarded based on survival placement rather than raw kill count.Level & Visual PolishTerrain Overhaul: Levels now feature proper loot crates, final decorations, and fewer accidental death pits.Swine

events.title: Updated Playtest
events.summary: Hey everyone! 👋We want to give a massive thank you to everyone who participated in the playtest. Your reports have helped us track down a bug that was heavily impacting the experience for many of you. 🤔 What was happening? We detected a configuration issue that was forcing every single player worldwide to connect to the Europe server, regardless of where they live.
